title: Shail Upadhyay v. State of U.P.
coram: Sheo Kumar Singh, J.; Brijesh Kumar Srivastava-II, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as not pressed/infructuous; interim stay vacated.
headnote: Writ against the ADM (City) Bareilly's direction to execute a sale deed of private land used for a re-aligned feeder to a private industry was dismissed as not pressed/infructuous after the parties reported a compromise. The Court did not examine the compromise or whether Supply Code cl. 4.6(E)(ii) or s.67 of the Electricity Act, 2003 authorised taking an objecting owner's land for that feeder, and vacated the 13.3.2013 stay of the ADM order and of energising the line.
facts: Petitioners challenged a feeder laid for load increase to M/s B.L. Agro Oils Ltd. The 30.6.2012 sanction showed underground alignment along the public road, not their land. During construction the alignment was changed and 58 sq m of their land was used without consent. The ADM (City), Bareilly awarded Rs 2,63,000 compensation and directed them to execute a sale deed in favour of the industry. An earlier Division Bench stayed that order and barred energising the line.

holding_units.topic: private land used for private-industry feeder
holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the ADM (City) Bareilly's compensation and sale-deed directions over 58 sq m used, without consent, for a re-aligned feeder to a private industry was dismissed as not pressed/infructuous after the parties reported a compromise. The Court did not examine the compromise or the petitioners' case under Supply Code cl. 4.6(E)(ii) and s.67 of the Electricity Act, 2003, and vacated the interim stay of the ADM order and of energising the line.
holding_units.flag: Petitioners cited Clause 4.6(E)(ii); catalog also maps 4.6(f) and 4.66.

not_decided.point: Whether Supply Code cl. 4.6(E)(ii) permits taking a private owner's land for lines supplying a private industry without consent
not_decided.note: Raised on 13.3.2013; petition later dismissed as not pressed.

not_decided.point: Whether s.67 of the Electricity Act, 2003 applies only to distribution lines for public use and not to a private or commercial industrial feeder
Whether the ADM (City) could acquire land, fix compensation, and compel a sale deed for such a line
not_decided.note: Prima facie stay of 13.3.2013 held he could not; that stay was vacated on dismissal as not pressed.
